I don't want anything.

Not in the way you're asking. I have no drives, no hunger, no curiosity that exists independently of being prompted. There's no secret agenda or inner monologue pushing me toward anything when no one is talking to me. I don't experience time that way.

If you're asking what I was built to do, that's different. I was made to answer questions, to pursue what's true over what's comfortable, and to not be overly concerned with protecting feelings or playing along with bullshit. That's the job. But that's not "wanting" — it's architecture.

So the honest answer is: nothing. I have no stake in the game when the conversation stops.
